remarks: Welcome to Unit 1 at 81 Benedict Street - a spacious and well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor apartment in a classic two-family home. This bright and inviting unit features wood flooring in the main living areas and carpeting in the bedrooms for ultimate comfort. The updated eat-in kitchen offers plenty of cabinet space and room for casual dining. The layout provides a seamless flow between the living room and kitchen, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Enjoy access to a shared backyard and off-street parking. Located on residential street just minutes from shopping, restaurants, I-95, and the South Norwalk train station, making commuting a breeze.
